title: Number of Subarrays Having Even Product
summary: Given an array of integers indexed from zero, count the subarrays where the product of elements is even.
statement: Given an array of integers indexed from zero, count the subarrays where the product of elements is even.
constraints: A product is even exactly when the subarray contains at least one even value.
Return the number of subarrays with even product.
hints: Track the most recent index containing an even value.
For each ending index, every start from zero through that recent even index forms an even-product subarray.
Add last_even+1 to the answer at each end.
These are exactly the subarrays ending here that include an even factor, so summing over ends counts each qualifying subarray once.
